result.question: How do I clean the condenser coil on the rooftop unit?
result.answer: See the quoted manual steps below.
result.model_answer: See the quoted manual steps below.

citations_shown.quote: At least once each year, or more often if the unit is located in a “dirty” environment, clean the evaporator and condenser coils using the instructions outlined below.

cleaning of the coil with the pressure washer aimed perpendicular to the face of the coil during cleaning.
maintain a minimum clearance of 6" between the sprayer nozzle and the coil.
a. do not allow sprayer pressure to exceed 600 psi.
b. the minimum nozzle spray angle is 15 degrees.
d. spray the solution perpendicular (at 90 degrees) to the coil face.
6. Spray the leaving-airflow side of the coil first; then spray the opposite side of the coil. Allow the cleaning solution to stand on the coil for five minutes.
7. Rinse both sides of the coil with cool, clean water.
8. Inspect both sides of the coil; if it still appears to be dirty, repeat Step 6 and Step 7.
9. Reinstall all of the components and panels removed in Step 1 and any protective covers installed in Step 2.
